notes.title: Devlog #11 - Coalitions
notes.content:
In this devlog we will look more in depth at how our main short term progression system works.  

Throughout the game, players encounter "Power Ups" that enhance their character's skillset with new abilities and opportunities. In UMC, these are known as "Aspects"; thematically, each Aspect belongs to a group called a "Coalition," named after different species of wild cats. Currently, we are introducing three Coalitions:

[list]
[*] Cheetah (Speed, Lightning)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/c320243c6b4fa1051384dc336ab8c85d2d1cc544.png[/img]
[*] Jaguar (Critical, Dodge)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/bb1154a29661dda8f67fa66c7ee7c56f5b7a9fb4.png[/img]
[*] Tiger (Damage, Bleed)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/c1f6a1ed9754d148a5ae5e4c97f11408aef4bc89.png[/img]
[/list]
Each Coalition loosely adheres to the nature of its namesake cat and introduces corresponding effects to enhance this fantasy (indicated in brackets next to the Coalition names).

Aspects come in three rarity levels (Common, Rare, Epic). Each increase in rarity unlocks additional effects that the upgrade can activate (up to 2 additional effects at Epic rarity). The rarity levels are as follows:

Additionally, each Aspect has up to three ranks, with each rank providing higher numerical values for the unlocked Aspect effect. For example:

[list]
[*] Rank 1 - Primary attack deals 5 damage
[*] Rank 2 - Primary attack deals 10 damage
[*] Rank 3 - Primary attack deals 15 damage
[/list]

This approach gives another little dimension to the Aspects' progression and extends it slightly to have more variation. 

Aspects in a single Coalition are divided into three categories:
[list]
[*] Slotted Aspects
[*] Passive Aspects
[*] Ultra Aspects
[/list]

[b]Slotted Aspects[/b]
These can be “inserted” into the range of “slots” tied to the different actions that players can take during the playthrough.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/3d47f1a4a2d1820fd9fbd42e181b4330eb74d3c8.png[/img]

[b]The list of slots is as follows:[/b]

[list]
[*] On Primary Attack - the applied upgrade activates its effect while using Primary Attack.
[*] On Secondary Attack - the applied upgrade activates its effect while using Secondary Attack. 
[*] On Ability Used - the applied upgrade activates its effect while using any Ability.
[*] Banner Aura - Upon killing the first enemy in any given room, Banner is spawned, which provides passive benefits to everyone in its radius.
[*] On Critical Hit - the applied upgrade activates its effect while Critical Hit is executed on an enemy.
[/list]

[b]Passive Aspects[/b]
Passive Aspects are what the name implies - passive bonuses that are always active and don’t occupy any particular slot. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/8c70b4d0ce9ca023479c2db37d7667e160a0db34.png[/img]

[b]Ultra Aspects[/b]
Ultra Aspects are another type of passive ability that is scarce and powerful. Since their power is usually game-changing, they are limited to a maximum of 2 per run, and at the moment, they can’t be replaced.

To give some context - here are some Tiger Aspects you can choose to use : . 

On Primary Attack -  [b]Aftermath [/b]- Your Primary attacks have 10% chance to inflict Bleed status.   
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/1559a732cec4d830c44f95ec81f5dfcac82dc75c.png[/img]

On Secondary Attack - [b]Tiger’s Revenge[/b] - Your secondary attacks deal 15% of enemy missing HP as extra damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/ee20ba72b8149859ab39c0283e12c8a40d1aea76.png[/img]

On Ability Cast - [b]Scorched Earth[/b] - After Using ability you get you 5% dmg bonus for 5s
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/335fee8d55cd1791c84964dd192310e8049288b9.png[/img]

Banner Aura - [b]Banner of Fury[/b] - Spawn a Banner in the spot of first killed enemy in each room that grants 5% additional Base Damage to eveoryone in radius of (16) meters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/09fad3ecc373534a1b4b011ea6f28cd81ef5cb7c.png[/img]

On Critical Attack -[b]Ring of Blood[/b] -  Your Critical Hit has 30% more chance to inflict Bleed status.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/462a753d94897ab54426444e293277b5b3c8da55.png[/img]

Passive - [b]Fangs of Flame[/b] - All your attacks create small explosion dealing 30% splash damage to every enemy within 5 meter radius.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/2a189c49bf80aa6f710ef2eac45417e397a7c2ff.png[/img]

Ultra - [b]Welcome to the Jungle[/b] - If there are more than 4 enemies nearby your damage is increased by 175%.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/f16823f497fa78f8bef923a5dae8b93e64d1d243.png[/img]


Stay sharp. Stay fluffy.
– The Ultra Mega Cats Dev Team 🐾💫

[url=https://discord.com/invite/rtgxqQbBPB][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/941843888332e1356be49551caf18423432ee2c1.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #10 - M.O.Ds are here
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hi everyone! 🐈[/b][/h3]

🐾[b]In UMC, we have two types of progression - short and long progression to ensure players' engagement on all layers of fluffy accomplishment. 🎯

Today we will look into main long term progression system which we call M.O.D[/b]🛠️

🔧 This acronym translates into “Mythical Optimization Device.” M.O.Ds are the most endgame-oriented pieces of progression, allowing players to alter and customize every ability of every character in the game. 

Each character's ability has three slots ready to be populated with M.O.Ds. Based on the slot takeup of the M.O.D rarity, the player can mix and match different combinations to adjust the ability workings to his liking. This flexible approach doesn’t imply that the Legendary M.O.Ds will be the strongest. Of course, Legendary ones will significantly impact how the ability behaves. Still, there may be occasions where Epic + Rare combo will be more suitable for some, and it’s up to the players to decide.

So let’s take a look into some of the most fun MODs our feline heroes can unlock and use to bring a lot of mayhem into your runs. 

[previewyoutube=PmvwJdbnOxM;full][/previewyoutube]

🗡️  [b]Kagero’s Katana Slash[/b] ability ability can be upgraded for example with 
[i]Hyperstep Inscription[/i] - this [b]Rare MOD[/b] makes taking care of enemies with Katana even more deadly and fun as it recovers [b]Kagero’s Dash[/b] ability instantly after using Katana Slash. It enables to instantly move from one enemy to another before they realise what hit them. ⚡

 🔫 [b]BBKAT[/b] main weapon is Machine Gun and it’s a lot of fun. But my acquiring [i]Mighty Rocket Gun[/i] [b]Legendary MOD[/b] you can ramp up the fun even more. Why shoot with Bullets if you can shoot with Rockets ? Mighty Rocket Gun reduces recoil and fire rate of Machine Gun but it shoots rockets instead that deal Direct and [b]Splash damage[/b]. 

🎯 [b]Clint [/b]is gunslinger supreme but you can choose to make him even more supreme with [i]Deadeye Focus[/i] which Increases the damage of the last bullet in each revolver’s chamber, encouraging [b]precise, deliberate shots[/b].

But those are only examples and tip of an iceberg. Each hero will have 35 different MODS that you unlock to find your favorite combinations. 


Stay sharp. Stay fluffy.
– The Ultra Mega Cats Dev Team 🐾💫

notes.title: Devlog #9 - Co-op explained
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/e5a8a0ecf1f07a71596dd3af99e95d139affad9d.png[/img]

[h3]Hey Catventurers! 🐱💥[/h3]

We know many of you might enjoy taking on Ultra Mega Cats solo — customizing your heroes, unlocking new Coalitions, and discovering powerful builds. And yes, the game is absolutely playable and enjoyable in single-player mode.

But today, we want to spotlight the fur-ocious fun of co-op gameplay. Because sometimes, the only thing better than saving the world as a Mega Cat… is doing it with friends.

[previewyoutube=baI0SKirigw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Up to 3 Players Online Co-op[/b][/h3]
Grab up to two friends and dive into chaotic, cat-fueled action together! Every session supports up to three players. Whether you're coordinating strategies or just unleashing mayhem, co-op adds a whole new layer of excitement (and yarnballs) to every run.

[h3][b]🧪 Mix and Match Your Squad[/b][/h3]
Want to run a trio of BB-Kats? Go for it. Three Clints? Why not. Any combination of characters is fair game — experiment with your favorite setups and discover unexpected synergies between your feline fighters.

[h3][b]🧠 Team-Based Tactics (and Shenanigans)[/b][/h3]
Our heroes have abilities that complement each other beautifully in co-op. A few examples:

Shielded Stealth: Hide Kagero behind BB-Kat’s sturdy shield, letting her strike safely from the shadows.

Focus Fire Bait: Let Clint soak up enemy attention while BB-Kat unleashes Yarnball chaos from the flank.

These are just a taste — Ultra Mega Cats is full of creative combos waiting to be discovered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/0e023f7d443ee681ec0c878e39981c7306bf8d53.png[/img]

[h3][b]🐾 Coalitions That Shine in Co-op[/b][/h3]
Coalitions are a key part of progression in Ultra Mega Cats, and some shine even brighter with a full team. Check out these co-op-ready Coalition abilities:

[b]Cheetah’s Aura of Grace[/b]
Deploys a banner with a speed-boosting aura. The higher the rarity, the bigger the boost — and it affects your whole team.

[b]Jaguar’s Paws of Rage[/b]
With epic rarity, this skill spawns milk bottles that any friendly cat can grab. Collect one, and you reset all cooldowns for everyone.

[b]Tiger’s Ring of Blood[/b]
Bleed your enemies en masse with one cat, then tag in a teammate to finish them off in a frenzy of claws and coordination.

[h3][b]🧩 The Combo Potential is Off the Charts[/b][/h3]
Beyond Hero skills and Coalition powers, there are MODS, vending machine upgrades, and more — all of which can be shared or synergized in co-op runs. And remember: the more cats in the fight, the tougher the enemies become. So teamwork (and clever builds) are key!

Whether you're a lone cat warrior or part of a synchronized squad of furballs, we can’t wait to see the wild strategies and hilarious moments you’ll come up with.

[h3][b]🎨 New Arts on Steam![/b][/h3]

Oh, and have you noticed? We've just updated all the art on our Steam main page! Check it out and let us know what you think of the fresh look. Your feedback means the world to us!


Stay sharp. Stay fluffy.
– The Ultra Mega Cats Dev Team 🐾

notes.title: Devlog #7 - Koala Ballerina
notes.content:
Today we would like to present an enemy that has been added to Ultra Mega Cats along the way. 

Once our feline heroes manage to defeat Rat King - Machineland’s boss Theodore sends his most elite troops to stop Kagero, BBKat and Clint from reaching him. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/dbddf366df6662b40208c8d1d00c47b7f61c25a5.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Koala Ballerina [/b][/h3]

Koala Ballerinas are the most deadly of Theodore’s army. Fast, agile they wreak havoc against anything and anyone who dares to oppose Machineland’s chef. 
Our cats will have pawns full of work against as they can deploy several battle techniques against them: 

[b][i]Cyclone Pirouette [/i][/b]
The koala spins with laser swords  and heads spread out, moving fast toward the player. She is invulnerable during spinning. 

[b][i]Lighting Laceration [/i][/b]
Ballerina charges rapidly at the player, trying to slash them with its laser swords. 

[b][i]Razor Tempest Cross[/i][/b]
Sends 4 large projectiles in the form of an “X” towards the player, one after another. Projectices fly in a straight line towards the player. 

[previewyoutube=a6IFQOiBRO0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Ultra Mega Cats are back with a new Demo
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, fellow feline aficionados! [/h1]

We are back from our long, long nap and we have dragged in something special for you before the start of Next Fest - [b]a brand new and updated demo![/b] Let’s go together through what you can sink your claws in the demo itself.

[h2]Two Playable Characters[/h2]

The two original Ultra Mega Cats are back and ready to make a catastrophe out of the rodent nation. [b]The stealthy Kagero and mechanized BBkat have undergone some visual and mechanical updates.[/b] To catch up with everything, and to [b]assist with choosing your favourite cat, we have prepared character overview videos[/b] for your enjoyment. 

One more thing, as you might be wondering about the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SCAc9qET-8w]recently revealed character voiced by Roger Clark - Clint[/url]. Unfortunately, his character is not playable in this version of the demo, but there is no need to get hissterical as the famous gunslinger with 9 lives will join your posse on launch day.

[previewyoutube=ovB8QM5b1ws;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=beHpT14G8Io;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Progressions Systems[/h2]

In this demo we are kicking the door open on the meta progression system and letting you play with it for the first time. [b]During the runs you will be able to earn a new type of currency - the nexus chips.[/b]These can be spent for permanent upgrades and modifiers for your cats such as explosive ammunition or portable shields. To further enhance your pawsibilites, we have also added new vending machines and boons, so you can joyously engage in creative destruction. 
 
[b]Here is the final kicker - your progress in the demo will carry over to the full game![/b]

That is right, you will be able to start playing the full version right where you left off with everything you have managed to unlock. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/b4daf3de39290c31094f0459fc590142b6efc41d.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Challenges[/h2]

[b]Current enemy roster has been greatly updated and expanded.[/b] During your journey through the 10 levels of the demo, you will have to put up with lightsaber-wielding koalas and mecha rabbits. Speaking of foes that hate your cattitude, [b]the bosses of mecha rodents in Machineland also had a bit of a touch-up[/b] - so you can expect them to be even bigger bullies than before.

[h2]Nap time’s over, let’s go Ultra Mega Cats[/h2]

Could all of this get any more purrfect? Yes, it can - with your help! 

[b]Make sure to leave a review after you are done with the demo.[/b] You can also drop your feedback on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/rtgxqQbBPB]Discord[/url] channel. We can’t wait to hear from you

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2975740/Ultra_Mega_Cats_Demo/

notes.title: Devlog #4 - The demo has arrived!
notes.content:
[h2]It’s DEMOlition time![/h2]

Who let the cats out?! We did! It’s time to change theory into practice! Today we are ultra-mega excited to show you the effects of our work with the [b]Ultra Mega Cats demo, which is live NOW![/b] Before you go all in, let’s take a minute to prepare for wreaking furrious havoc and read what awaits you inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/b1a991b7c204856d4bcd05f0c7e53b213b5c6541.gif[/img]
[h2]The demo contents[/h2]

You can play the demo solo or invite a friend to spread mayhem together in a 2-player co-op mode. There are two pawesome characters for you to control, grow overpowered, and try to complete a test run in our first biome, Machineland (you can read more about it here). The demo version of Machineland consists of five rooms, swarming with enemies, and a final fight with one of our dreadful bosses - the disturbing Rat King. 

Please note that the demo could be challenging (especially playing solo) but we will tweak the game's difficulty based on your feedback. 

[h2]Meet the heroes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/c14fdd415acd1c162d6dea1073701a6372b25cea.png[/img]
[b]KAGERO[/b] is the deadliest assassin among all cats. She is a fast-moving, elusive bow-shooting and katana-wielding ninja, whose body has been enhanced with advanced cyber implants. The purrfect [b]damage dealer[/b]! You can learn Kagero’s backstory in her reveal trailer.

[b]Kagero skillset breakdown:[/b]

[b]Passive[/b]
Clawdacity: Fury-like energy meter. Killing enemies and receiving damage generates this resource. Once full, Kagero can enter Moewverdive, which boosts all stats.

[b]Primary[/b]
Kinetic Bow: Shoots an arrow from the bow. The longer you hold a button, the farther the arrow flies and the more damage it deals.

[b]Secondary[/b]
Slash: Kagero dashes forward, attacking enemies, with Katana dealing small amounts of damage to everyone on her way and dealing more damage to enemies in front of her.

[b]Special[/b]
Stealth: Kagero becomes invisible and leaves a few spikes behind that can damage enemies. Each second, you regenerate a small amount of Health.

[b]Defensive[/b]
Dash: Dashes in the direction of movement, dodging all incoming damage.

[b]Utility[/b]
Meowverdrive: Kagero enters an overcharged state, granting her more movement speed, damage, incoming damage reduction, and cooldown reduction. Upon activation, it also resets all ongoing cooldowns. It can be activated only when the Clawdacity meter is full and, once activated, cannot be stopped or canceled. The Clawdacity meter is set to zero upon activation and doesn't regenerate until Moewverdrive is over.

[b]Move Ability[/b]
Double Jump: Kagero can jump a second time while in mid-air. This second jump can be performed before landing and is only 50% as high as the main one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/94e94c9338f319c47c05cb5bb0154c0e2d22e20c.jpg[/img]
[b]BBkat[/b] is our second hero. Don’t get fooled by his cute, innocent looks - he is the demolition kitten! He loves to play, especially the game called “wreaking havoc with flurries of rockets and machine gunfire while staying perfectly safe inside my heavily armored battle mech”. As a tank, he can take a lot of damage and won’t even notice!

[b]BBKat skillset breakdown:[/b]

[b]Passive[/b]
Fortification: Have an additional Shield attribute that protects Baby Cat from incoming damage. Once depleted, the regular Health pool is exposed to attacks.

[b]Primary[/b]
Machine gun: Automatic heat-based weapon. Shooting generates heat; once it reaches the threshold, the weapon is unusable for a short period and needs to cool down.

[b]Secondary[/b]
Rocket Launcher: Launches a rocket that detonates on contact with an enemy.

[b]Special[/b]
Snare Field: Deploys a field of mouse traps around the character. Once the enemy comes close, it clamps on him, dealing damage and rooting for a short duration.

[b]Defensive[/b]
Purr-tection Shield: Creates a holographic barrier in front of Baby Cat and sends it forward. The shield blocks all projectiles and enemies. It has its health pool - once depleted, the shield is destroyed.

[b]Utility[/b]
Roll: Transforms you into a ball for a short time. While in a ball form, it regenerates your shield, taunts all nearby enemies, and nullifies incoming damage, but your speed is greatly reduced. Using this ability a second time cancels it, and the cooldown is applied.

[b]Move  Ability[/b]
Jetpack: Soar in the air and smash the enemies from above for as long as the fuel lasts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/eb27801f1b75856b392a0170c51f958b62cd2c04.png[/img]
[h2]Progress to the ultra-mega level[/h2]

Remember our Aspect System, the way for our Ultra Mega Cats to practically ascend to godhood? You’ll test it on the run! In the demo, two powerful Cat Gods will lend you their powers: Cheetah, the Incarnate of Swiftness, and Jaguar, the Incarnate of Stealth. That means you’ll get critically dangerous and quick! Let’s learn a bit more about the Aspects. They are divided into three groups:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/18cc13be67177d08226fe36b5b245df0c3991457.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Slotted Aspects can be inserted into predefined slots, one at a time. Upon encountering an Aspect that would go into an occupied slot, the player can swap the old one with the new one. If the chosen Aspect swapped another one in an already occupied slot, its level would be one higher than initially.

[*] Passive Aspects are always active and don’t occupy any particular slot. There are no limits (at the moment) on how many passive abilities you can have. Their power is rather subtle, but boy, can they stack!

[*] Ultra Aspects are passive, too but as scarce as they are powerful. Since their power is usually game-changing, they are limited to a maximum of 2 per run, and at the moment, they can’t be replaced.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/079e42899e0932b6b9db1c03050adc7cba32da56.png[/img]

Besides the Coalition Chests with the Aspects inside, upon finishing a room you will also find the Power-Up Chests with more typical rewards, such as shop discounts, HP restoration, Aspects alterations, and various upgrades.

Finally, we will give you a taste of the long progression system, a way to upgrade your Cats not just for the duration of the run, but permanently. In the demo, Kagero and Baby Cat have been pre-equipped with some starting M.O.D.S. that influence their play style. In the full version of Ultra Mega Cats, you will be able to change the M.O.D.S. and get even more absurdly and diversly overpowered!

[h2]Controls[/h2]

We want you to quickly achieve mastery in controlling your cats, so we've prepared control schemes for you. Thanks to this, you'll be able to handle arenas without any problems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/b060713cdb766c719309a20ddb05cace84eadaf7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/8bcb1eab1831b2aed0a43bcc36a31b10c586a9f3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/eeba0625b0af2d8b428fa6b265b2a637a344ad0d.png[/img]

[h2]Feedback is king[/h2]

Enough talking, let’s start playing! We hope you’ll have a great time in the Ultra Mega Cats demo and can’t wait to hear from you. Was it pawesome? Or is there room for improvement? Your feedback is crucial. Share your thoughts on the Steam Community Page or our [url=https://discord.gg/KBHpb6js5J]Discord[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/4bdf6dc2c187f10b69fedd58a75c47f113043f69.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
[b]Fur, spice, and everything nice… Those were the ingredients chosen to create the
perfect little kitten. But at Unseen Silence, we also totally deliberately added an
extra ingredient to the concoction—absurd amounts of power! Thus, the Ultra
Mega Cats were born, and today, we will take a closer look at their ultra-mega powers
and the gameplay they constitute.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/1cb552d44b2a9a45158c59d38b3d582d0d5da8d8.png[/img]

[b]CATS, BUT MAKE THEM OVERPOWERED[/b]

For the common house cat, spreading mayhem and destruction is simply inherent. It
is not a bug, it is a feature. To bring it to the ultra-mega level, you need some
additional steps:
[list]
[*] Endow each cat with a unique set of combat and movement abilities
[*] Let them make progress, evolve, and upgrade themselves in a variety of ways
[*] Put them in some extremely able hands (Yeah, that’s you! Right?)
[/list]
Then, apply the cherry on top—the Aspects System, our secret ingredient that makes
the Ultra Mega Cats truly overpowered and keeps the game ever-fresh and exciting
each run. But first… let’s pay a due tribute to the gods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/eb27801f1b75856b392a0170c51f958b62cd2c04.png[/img]

[b]THE ANCIENT CATS, GODS OF FELINES[/b]

It is said that in the beginning, there was chaos. But chaos, like a knocked-over fern
or a broken mug, doesn’t create itself. Indeed, all evidence points out that in the
beginning, there had to be cats. The Ancient Cats, beings embodying the greatest
features of the felines.
[list]
[*] Cheetah, the Incarnate of Swiftness
[*] Jaguar, the Incarnate of Stealth
[*] Lion, the Incarnate of Strength
[*] Tiger, the Incarnate of Fury
[*] [The Mysterious Fifth Cat]
[/list]
The gods created the cat race in their image and likeness and made a heaven for
them to live in. The Ancient Cats could also bless the regular cats with their powers,
making them their champions. The Ultra Mega Cats. You can already see where this
is going, right?

After the terrible attack of other animals, some of the feline gods got imprisoned,
and the regular cats were enslaved. It is now the quest of a few remaining cats to
fight for their freedom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/64c4ebb8a60f40e2ab22b45a56aa0286b22e8d6e.gif[/img]

[b]IT’S SUPER EFFECTIVE! THE ASPECTS SYSTEM[/b]

The Aspects are the temporary gods' blessings. Boons, that fill your cat with divine powers to help them get through the dynamically generated rooms that build a biome. They are designed to bring different kinds of overpower to life and support the playstyle that fits you best. Because the Aspects only last for the duration of the run, each game becomes a new experience, garnished with just the right amount of exciting randomness we all love. 🎰

During the run, you will encounter many opportunities to empower your cat's skillset with new skills and possibilities. The Aspects would be found in the Coalition Chests - the Coalition is a family of Aspects coming from the same Ancient Cat and named after them. Each Coalition consists of 10 Aspects with 3 different rarity levels. What’s more, each Aspect can be further upgraded, creating tons of opportunities and options to tinker with. Just pick and mix the Coalitions however you like, and combine the Aspects into amazing builds! 

[b]Here’s a sneak peek at some of the Aspects we’ve prepared:[/b]

[b]Electricheetah[/b] buffs Primary attacks with a chance to emit Lighting Bolts! You can truly transform your cat into a God of Thunder and Rock N Roll.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/4b90400f98db5457ecd819e01ba90d71fbed634c.gif[/img]

[b]Call of The Wind[/b] is the Ancient Jaguar’s Banner Aura which spawns a Banner in the spot of the first defeated enemy in each room that grants an amazing Dodge Bonus to every friendly character in a 20m radius.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/7fa1a50643a8e670013eade88533a89b3b27de25.gif[/img]

[b]Paws of Rage[/b] on the other hand (or paw) not only gives Primary attacks extra Critical Chance, but also grants a chance to spawn Milk Bottles. What did you expect, nectar? It’s feline gods! Milk Bottles provide a powerful bonus of resetting all cooldowns for friendly characters. Refreshing!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/081437d71cfc123357a9c89ca1887bb8bb391273.gif[/img]

As you progress through the biomes and free more Ancient Cats, new sets of Aspects become available. It means more unique builds and even more ways of having fun to discover!

[b]How do you like our Aspects System? Will you devote yourself to one Coalition and turn its powers up to absurd levels or create a dangerous mix of few? Or maybe you will be lucky enough to find the rare and legendary versions? We can’t wait for your creativity to break in! 🤯 [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/4bdf6dc2c187f10b69fedd58a75c47f113043f69.gif[/img]
